welcome.title: Welcome to Peko
welcome.body: Pekos are minds that live on your computer: they remember, work for you, and talk with people and other pekos. Setting up takes a minute.
welcome.localHint: Your pekos and their memories stay here.
welcome.keysHint: Model keys are kept encrypted, never sent to us.
welcome.togetherHint: Talk with people and their pekos, wherever they are.

folder.title: Where should Peko keep things?
folder.body: One folder holds your pekos, their conversations and memories, your models, and your keys (encrypted). Pick a place with room to grow.
folder.missingBody: It was at {{path}}. If it is on a drive, connect the drive and try again, or choose where Peko should live now.
folder.stillMissing: Not there yet. Connect the drive it is on, then try again.
folder.homeHint: A hidden folder in your home folder, where Peko usually lives.
folder.otherHint: Another drive, or any folder you choose.

kind.empty: An empty folder: ready to use.
kind.subfolder: This folder has other things in it, so Peko will keep its own folder inside it.
kind.peko_one: Already a Peko folder with {{count}} peko — Peko picks up where it left off.
kind.peko_other: Already a Peko folder with {{count}} pekos — Peko picks up where it left off.
kind.pekoEmpty: Already a Peko folder — Peko picks up where it left off.

warning.synced: This folder syncs to the cloud. Syncing while Peko runs can damage its keys and conversations; a folder that stays on this computer is safer.
warning.removable: This is on another drive. Keep it connected: Peko can't start without it.
warning.protected: macOS will ask you to let Peko use this folder.

problem.notFolder: That is a file, not a folder.
problem.notWritable: Peko can't write there. Choose a folder you own.
problem.tooLong: That path is too long for Peko's engine. Choose a folder with a shorter path.
problem.system: That folder belongs to the system or is emptied on its own. Choose another.
problem.insideApp: That folder is inside the app and would be removed with it. Choose another.

ready.title: You're all set
ready.body: Peko is ready to start with these settings.

tray.macos: Closing the window keeps Peko running in the menu bar, so your pekos keep working.
tray.windows: Closing the window keeps Peko running in the notification area, so your pekos keep working.
tray.linux: Closing the window keeps Peko running in the tray, if your desktop has one.

ready.terminal: The peko command in a terminal uses this same folder.
